name: Nefazodone
metabolism: Extensively metabolized through N-dealkylation and aliphatic/aromatic hydroxylation. Very little is eliminated as unchanged drug in urine; metabolites account for most clearance.
summary: Nefazodone is an atypical antidepressant used to treat depression. It was withdrawn in most countries after reports of serious liver toxicity, but the cited page reports generic availability in the United States.
